description: Full lifecycle control (Add/Edit/Modify) over internal/external courses and specialized learning paths.

capabilities: Create modular course structures with L1-L4 proficiency levels.
Define metadata: Duration, Faculty/Trainer, Weightage, and Difficulty.
Attach prerequisite requirements to prevent advanced enrollment before basics.
Versioning control for course content updates without losing historical data.
use_cases: Admin adds a new 40-hour 'Advanced Data Analytics' course with a prerequisite of 'Basic Statistics'.
L&D Team updates the syllabus for 'Corporate Compliance 2026' while maintaining records for the 2025 version.

capabilities: Bundle multiple courses and certifications into 'Skill Tracks' or 'Role Pathways'.
Define linear or branch-based progression (User chooses elective A or B).
Map tracks to organizational designations (e.g., 'Junior to Senior Developer Path').
Automated track subscription based on user designation synced from HRMS.
use_cases: Command Centre creates a 'Leadership Track' comprising 5 courses, 2 workshops, and 1 final project.
A user promoted to 'Lead Engineer' is automatically subscribed to the 'Senior Management Essentials' track.

capabilities: Onboard external certifications (AWS, PMP, NDT) into the internal catalog.
Map external completion proofs to internal skill weightages.
Automated link generation for third-party platforms (Udemy, Coursera, LinkedIn Learning).
use_cases: Admin maps an 'AWS Solutions Architect' external cert to 100 points in the 'Cloud Architecture' hot-skill leaderboard.
User clicks 'Start' on the dashboard and is redirected to the external provider's portal via SSO.

capabilities: Switch course mode between 'Online-Self Paced', 'Virtual-Instructor Led', and 'Physical Classroom'.
Manage batch sizes, venue allocation, and waitlist automation.
Trigger hardware/software surveys upon enrollment for technical labs.
use_cases: L&D manager modifies a course from Virtual to Physical for a specific batch due to hardware requirements.
System automatically moves the top-ranked user on a waitlist into an active slot after a cancellation.

capabilities: Set expiration/recertification dates for compliance-heavy courses.
Define 'Mandatory' vs. 'Optional' flags for targeted business units.
use_cases: Admin retires an outdated 'Legacy Software v1' course, hiding it from discovery but keeping it in 'Completed' histories.
Safety Officer sets a 'Fire Safety' course to expire every 365 days, triggering auto-reenrollment.
